## 简体中文

Sempre 2.0.1 是面向纯 Rust 2.0 版本的可靠性更新。

### 修复

- 新激活配置启动失败时，完整恢复此前的订阅部署状态，包括所选配置和配置构建元数据。
- Windows 上正常服务停止流程无法完成时，终止托管进程树，加强原生服务关闭可靠性。
- 正确引用包含空格或特殊字符的 systemd 工作目录。
- 让服务和回滚冒烟 fixture 不依赖主机透明代理支持，同时保留生产默认值。
- 将已确认的 RSA 安全通告严格限定到经验证对所有工作区目标均不可达的依赖。

### 安装

- macOS 和 Linux：运行 `curl -fsSL https://sempre.run/install | sh`。
- Windows：从下方资产下载匹配的平台包。

- [完整更新记录](https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v2.0.0...v2.0.1)

## English

### Sempre 2.0.1

Sempre 2.0.1 is a reliability update for the Rust-only 2.0 release.

### Fixes

- Restores the complete previous subscription deployment state when a newly activated configuration fails during startup, including the selected profile and configuration build metadata.
- Hardens native service shutdown on Windows by terminating the managed process tree when the normal service stop path cannot complete.
- Correctly quotes systemd working directories containing spaces or special characters.
- Keeps service and rollback smoke fixtures independent from host transparent-proxy support while preserving production defaults.
- Keeps the acknowledged RSA advisory narrowly scoped to a dependency that is verified as unreachable from every workspace target.

### Install

macOS and Linux:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://sempre.run/install | sh
```

Windows users can download the matching bundle from the assets below.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v2.0.0...v2.0.1
